subject: Request for post-report continuity letter covering SOC 2 period gap
messages:
From: Alyssa Turner <alyssa.turner@terraxa.com>
To: neha_kapoor@redwoodinference.com
Cc: procurement@terraxa.com
Date: Thu, 5 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Request: continuity letter to cover post-report period (SOC 2 Type II)

Hi Neha,

We're onboarding Redwood as a vendor for our clinical data pipelines and our procurement/security team requires a signed continuity statement (often called a bridge letter) to cover the period after your SOC 2 Type II report end date through the present. The SOC 2 report we have on file is for the period ending 2025-07-31. Our cutover date for vendor approvals is 2026-12-01, so we need coverage from 2025-08-01 to at least 2026-11-30.

Can Redwood provide:
- A signed post-report continuity letter that confirms there have been no material control changes or unremediated exceptions since 2025-07-31, or
- If an auditor-signed bridge is unavailable, a corporate attestation plus supporting evidence (change logs, incident summaries, patching cadence, list of major infrastructure changes).

I've attached our vendor risk form and the procurement checklist for reference. If you could confirm what you can provide and an ETA, that would help us move forward.

Thanks,

Alyssa Turner
Director, Vendor Security
Terraxa Health
alyssa.turner@terraxa.com
(415) 555-0198

Attachment: vendor-risk-form-terraxa.pdf (application/pdf)
Attachment: terraxa-procurement-checklist.docx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document)

From: neha_kapoor@redwoodinference.com <neha_kapoor@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alyssa Turner <alyssa.turner@terraxa.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com, connor_obrien@redwoodinference.com
Date: Fri, 6 Nov 2026 11:22:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request: continuity letter to cover post-report period (SOC 2 Type II)

Hi Alyssa —

Thanks for the details and for sending the procurement checklist. We can provide a formal Post-Report Continuity Letter (corporate attestation) signed by our VP of Security and General Counsel that:

- Confirms the SOC 2 Type II report period ended 2025-07-31 (we'll attach the report copy)
- States there have been no material exceptions or control degradations since the report period end through a specified coverage date
- Summarizes any significant infrastructure or process changes and points to supporting evidence (logs, change windows, patching reports)

To align with your compliance team: can you confirm whether Terraxa requires the letter to be countersigned or acknowledged by your auditor (AuditPartner LLP)? If so, we can reach out to our auditor and request an acknowledgement letter — that typically takes additional lead time.

For Redwood to prepare the corporate continuity letter we will need:
- The exact coverage end date you need (I see 2026-11-30 in your note; confirm)
- Any procurement language that must be echoed verbatim in the attestation (e.g., specific statements about encryption or data residency)
- Whether you need redwood to provide supporting artifacts (we can attach an operations summary and sample system change log).

I'll loop in Marissa (legal) for sign-off and Connor (security) to prepare the operations summary and curated evidence set. If everything looks good we can circulate a draft for your review and run through DocuSign.

ETA: Draft letter + evidence list by 2026-11-19 if we have confirmation on the coverage end date and auditor requirement.

Best,

Neha Kapoor
Head of Trust & Security
Redwood Inference
neha_kapoor@redwoodinference.com
(650) 555-0123

From: Alyssa Turner <alyssa.turner@terraxa.com>
To: neha_kapoor@redwoodinference.com
Date: Tue, 10 Nov 2026 14:07:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request: continuity letter to cover post-report period (SOC 2 Type II)

Neha —

Thanks, that sounds good. Confirmations below:

- Coverage end date: 2026-11-30 (Terraxa procurement will accept coverage through that date).
- Auditor acknowledgement: Preferred but not mandatory. If you can provide an auditor acknowledgement that would be ideal; otherwise the corporate attestation plus supporting artifacts is acceptable.
- Procurement language: Please include a line confirming encryption in transit and at rest for customer data, and that Redwood maintains role-based access controls for production systems.

We uploaded the vendor risk form to our procurement portal: https://procure.terraxa.com/risk-form/6321.

I'll plan to review your draft as soon as you send it. If you need a contact at AuditPartner for acknowledgements, their general mailbox is auditpartner@auditpartner.com.

Thanks again — Alyssa

--
Alyssa Turner
Director, Vendor Security
Terraxa Health
alyssa.turner@terraxa.com

From: neha_kapoor@redwoodinference.com <neha_kapoor@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alyssa Turner <alyssa.turner@terraxa.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com, connor_obrien@redwoodinference.com
Date: Fri, 19 Nov 2026 16:30:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request: continuity letter to cover post-report period (SOC 2 Type II)

Alyssa —

Appreciate the confirmation. Per our timeline, attached is Redwood's draft "Post-Report Continuity Letter" that covers 2025-08-01 through 2026-11-30. Highlights:

- Statement of coverage: The letter confirms there have been no material exceptions or unremediated control failures since the SOC 2 Type II report period ended 2025-07-31.
- Security confirmations: Includes explicit language on encryption in transit and at rest, and that RBAC is enforced for production services.
- Supporting evidence: We are attaching an operations summary and a curated sample of system change logs and patching cadence (redwood-ops-summary.pdf and change-log-sample.csv). For full evidence requests we can run an export under your PO/NDAs.

We can request an auditor acknowledgement from AuditPartner LLP; typical turnaround is 7-14 business days and may require their standard fee. Please let us know if you want us to pursue an auditor-signed acknowledgement. If you are OK with corporate attestation only, we'll finalize the draft and route for signature (VP Security + General Counsel) and provide a DocuSign link.

Next steps:
- Confirm whether auditor acknowledgement is required (reply to this thread).
- If no auditor acknowledgement: we will finalize, sign, and send via DocuSign by 2026-11-24.
- If auditor acknowledgement required: we'll contact AuditPartner and estimate delivery by 2026-12-07.

Attached: redwood-draft-continuity-letter.docx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document), SOC2_TypeII_Report_20250731.pdf (application/pdf)

Thanks — happy to jump on a quick call if you prefer to run through language.

Best regards,

Neha Kapoor
Head of Trust & Security
Redwood Inference
neha_kapoor@redwoodinference.com
(650) 555-0123
